description: This file contains implementation of a utility class 'FirstFlightExtractor' for creating a custom HTTP/3 session and QUIC connection to extract the first flight of packets sent, along with functions to generate and retrieve these packets, primarily for testing purposes within the QUIC protocol testing framework.

classes.name: FirstFlightExtractor
classes.description: A utility class that creates a custom HTTP/3 session and QUIC connection to extract the first flight of packets sent during the connection setup.

methods.name: GenerateFirstFlight
methods.description: Initializes the QUIC connection and session, and starts the process to generate the first flight of packets.

methods.name: OnDelegatedPacket
methods.description: Handles incoming packets and stores them for later retrieval.

methods.name: ConsumePackets
methods.description: Returns the collected packets and clears the internal storage.

methods.name: GetCryptoStreamBytesWritten
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes written to the crypto stream during the first flight.
